item.title: Mercury 2.5 Preview
item.description: Inception Labs released Mercury 2.5 Preview on August 31, 2026, the latest in its Mercury line of diffusion language models, a design that generates and refines multiple tokens in parallel rather than one at a time. Inception says the approach pushes throughput to 1,107 tokens per second on standard GPUs. Inception puts the intelligence gain over Mercury 2 at around 40 percent, in range with cost-optimized models like Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and Claude Haiku 4.5.
